migrations.name: to-v5
migrations.description: Rewrite the v4 core API into its v5 shape.

migrations.name: provider-shape
migrations.description: Rewrite destructured provider tuples into the tree-shakeable definition shape.

migrations.name: seo-directive-removed
migrations.description: SeoDirective and SeoConfig are gone. Every call site moves to the apply*Binding function for its key.

migrations.name: surface-interaction-swatch
migrations.description: Rewrite surface theme interactionColor maps into the { color, onColor, inkColor } swatch shape.

migrations.name: surface-theme-regenerate
migrations.description: Regenerate the surface theme stylesheet, so the new swatch reaches the CSS variables.

migrations.name: legacy-color-themes
migrations.description: Move the runtime color theming to Tailwind 4: provideColorThemes becomes provideColorThemesWithTailwind4, and the generated CSS and surface themes replace the runtime styles.

migrations.name: create-destroy
migrations.description: Rewrite takeUntil(this.destroy$) on a createDestroy() field into takeUntilDestroyed().

migrations.name: color-theme-variants
migrations.description: Rewrite surface theme colorTheme and semanticColorThemes into colorThemeVariants.

migrations.name: theme-token-names
migrations.description: Rename the old theme token names (surface, tone, opacity knob, component triplets) and the generated Tailwind color names.

migrations.name: surface-roles
migrations.description: Split surface theme interactionColor into tint and controlText, drop onColor and inkColor, and rename the readers of --et-surface-interaction*.

migrations.name: remove-surface-interactive
migrations.description: Remove etSurfaceInteractive, its marker class and its SurfaceInteractiveDirective imports.

migrations.name: semantic-color-theme-injects
migrations.description: injectErrorTheme, injectWarningTheme and injectSuccessTheme are gone: rewrite each call into injectSemanticColorTheme('<type>')().

migrations.name: color-theme-variants-required
migrations.description: SurfaceTheme colorTheme and semanticColorThemes are gone: rewrite them into colorThemeVariants.

migrations.name: legacy-color-themes-required
migrations.description: provideColorThemes and the runtime theme style helpers (createThemeStyle, createRootThemeCss, createSwatchCss, createTailwind*) are gone: move to provideColorThemesWithTailwind4 and the generated CSS.
